question.zh: 恒生指数在 2026-10-31 或之后首个交易日收盘，会高于 2026-10-24 吗？
question.en: Will Hang Seng close higher on the first trading day on or after 2026-10-31 than on 2026-10-24?

rationale.zh: 近 20 个交易日波动 1.12%/日，平均涨跌 -0.30%/日（按一半计入），周期约 5 个交易日（一周）。
rationale.en: 20-day volatility 1.12%/day; average move -0.30%/day, counted at half weight; about 5 trading days (one week).
